about.text: Cheese made with little or no acid and heated hard, boiled in its whey or baked, so that its protein network holds and it softens when grilled or fried instead of melting. Halloumi, cooked in whey at up to 90 °C, and Finland's leipäjuusto, baked or grilled after setting, are the best known.
